scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,client" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/game-core && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w packages/game-core && npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/client
